      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies txospenderindex and extracts shared logic into BaseIndex and index/block_seq.h under src/index/.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.60,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Significantly reduces txospenderindex resource usage by shrinking key entries by 33% (from 18 to 12 bytes). Previous experiments noted in the discussion showed the database size dropping from ~84GB to ~62GB alongside lower indexing times, while also decoupling the index from raw file positions to facilitate pruned mode."
    },

      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool data structures or transaction acceptance policy.",

      "score": 0,

    },

      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "The PR only modifies optional index code under src/index/."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Extracted utilities are index-specific (src/index/block_seq.h and BaseIndex::DB).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,

      "rationale": "The PR creates shared code specific to the index subsystem rather than shared general utilities across the node."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
